integrationGuard.baselineExpenseTreatment: Retained original operating profit/CFO already includes an unidentified embedded carbon expense. The legacy field name operatingProfitBeforeClimate and its separately tagged climateOperatingCost=0 do NOT establish that historical carbon expense was zero or removed.
integrationGuard.incrementOnly: New input is explicitly priceIncrementGbpPerUka, never an observed total price. Model keeps baseline expense intact and rebuilds only the matched future price-increment cost, recovery and receivable delta. No historical baseline removal or total-carbon-expense deduction.
integrationGuard.futureCashConvention: Future purchases in emissions year is a separately frozen prospective scenario convention, not an inference from 2024 compliance. Later legal surrender is not treated as evidence of when allowances were purchased or paid.
integrationGuard.zeroBoundary: Observed 2024 delivered allocation zero for UK-E-IN-12019 is actually present in the registry. Unknown historical banks/sale cash never become factual zeros. Future opening uncommitted bank zero and no discretionary sales are conditional scenario choices, not observed account balances or receipts.

conditionalForwardCalculation.observationVsAssumption: Source observations remain the FY2024 permit emissions/free allocations and FY2024 voting-ownership row. Every price increment, FX coordinate, future bank, allocation, pass-through, cash timing and common-burden choice is explicitly frozen in a separate assumptions object.
conditionalForwardCalculation.emissions: Hold selected absolute annual permit-reported tCO2e at FY2024 levels; no invented physical growth, free abatement, Scope 2/3 or native-CO2 conversion.
conditionalForwardCalculation.unitConvention: Explicit conditional 1 UKA per reported tCO2e; statutory denomination/covered-gas annex not independently retrieved within the bounded attempt. Do not label the conditional unit convention a new authenticated legal citation.
conditionalForwardCalculation.price: Model INCREMENTAL price shocks only. Existing embedded carbon expense/price level is unidentified and is NOT deducted again. GBP1 normalization is a coefficient, not an observed UKA price; GBP25 is a standardized adverse price-increment stress, not an auction forecast.
conditionalForwardCalculation.priceIndex: Incremental nominal price follows the retained original operating revenue index solely as a frozen stress-index convention, preserving the original five-year/ten-year fade/2.5-4% terminal; not a causal carbon-price forecast.
conditionalForwardCalculation.currency: Native cost GBP; USD conversion requires an explicit future conditional USD/GBP. Unit-normalization uses 1; adverse stresses use 1.25. Neither is reported as an observed dated FX quote.
conditionalForwardCalculation.banking: Future opening UNCOMMITTED bank zero is conservative, not an observed account balance. Use bank-first settlement; earmark current obligations for later legal surrender; no speculative allowance sales, terminal bank liquidation or inference from cumulative surrenders.
conditionalForwardCalculation.allocation: Future delivered allowances held at actual 2024 units, or zero as adverse sensitivity; no future award or statutory phaseout fabricated.
conditionalForwardCalculation.cashTiming: Prospective purchase in emissions year; earmarked units cover later surrender. Uncommitted bank excludes earmarked obligations. This is a cash-purchase convention, not a claim about actual historical purchase/surrender dates.
conditionalForwardCalculation.passThroughAndTax: No recovery/no marginal tax shield is conservative. Half recovery with one-year collection lag is a sensitivity, not a source-estimated contract. Recognized recovery, collections and incremental AR are separately reconciled.
conditionalForwardCalculation.commonBurden: Full incremental common-cash burden is an explicit conservative prospective assumption for the 100%-voting subsidiary, not an observed equity-emissions ownership allocation or new NCI fact.
conditionalForwardCalculation.terminalProtection: Reject integration when positive uncommitted bank would eventually deplete beyond the horizon; never capitalize a temporarily bank-funded zero cost as an infinite terminal exemption.
conditionalForwardCalculation.fundedIntegration: Rebuild climate operating cost, recovery revenue/profit, opening/closing AR, collections, CFO and FCFE. Preserve every original fixed-capital/replacement, debt proceeds/repayments, interest, cash tax, non-common reserve, cash reserve and dated stub. Additional recovery does not imply new physical volume; no second debt subtraction or excess-cash release.
conditionalForwardCalculation.basis: Six STORED original XOM source-conditioned/constraint cases at terminal growth 2.5%, 3.25%, 4%, each with four NEW component scenarios
conditionalForwardCalculation.originalWholeCompanyQualification: 0/3; twenty-four conditional components are NOT twenty-four qualified original cases
